rush.name: Rush
rush.describe: They carry the puck straight at the net.

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.describe: They work the puck round the zone to the point and the wing.

dump.name: Dump and chase
dump.describe: They shoot the puck into the corner under pressure and go after it.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.describe: One of yours goes after the puck in their end; the others drop back.

press.name: Press
press.describe: Two of yours chase the carrier deep in their end. Wins pucks high up the ice, but tires your line faster and leaves room behind them.

sit.name: Sit back
sit.describe: All three wait at your blue line. Hard to get a breakaway against, but they get the neutral zone for nothing.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.describe: Your linemates shoot and pass as each sees fit.

rush.name: Rush
rush.describe: Carry it in and shoot early. More shots, from further out.

cycle.name: Cycle
cycle.describe: Pass it round the zone until a lane opens. Better chances, but more passes to pick off.

crash.name: Crash
crash.describe: Both your linemates go to the front of the net for screens, tips and rebounds. Nobody is left at the point if the puck comes out.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.describe: One presses the carrier, one guards the slot, one takes a man.

collapse.name: Collapse
collapse.describe: Pack the slot in front of your net. Hard to score on from in close, but they get their shots from the point.

man.name: Man-to-man
man.describe: Everyone takes a man and nobody guards the slot. More pressure on the puck, but one good pass leaves the middle open.
